annotations.title: Get Gazette Notice Text and Fields

description:
Fetch a Gazette notice's full legal wording and labelled fields by notice ID.

Returns text (the full notice wording), title, notice_code, notice_type,
category, publication_date (YYYY-MM-DD), company_number, company_name,
previous_company_name and notice_url. Fields the notice does not carry
are null. Legacy notices (L-.../E-... IDs) usually carry no structured
company number: a null company_number means the notice has no structured
number, not that it concerns a different company; read the text. Use
gazette_insolvency first to find notice_numeric_id values.

notice_id.description: Gazette notice ID: numeric (e.g. '4420724') or legacy (e.g. 'L-57793-2040', 'E-26343-2431-168'). Returned as notice_numeric_id by gazette_insolvency.

name: gazette_notice

outputSchema.description:
One Gazette notice: its full wording plus the labelled fields it carries.

Read from the notice's XHTML+RDFa page (GET /notice/{id}, Accept:
application/xml). A field the notice does not carry is null (unknown),
never an empty string.

company_name.description: Company name from the notice's structured data; null when absent.

company_number.description: Companies House number from the notice's structured data. Null means the notice carries no structured number (common on legacy notices), not that it is about a different company: check the text. Never parsed from the text.

notice_code.description: Gazette notice code (e.g. '2410' appointment of administrators, '2452' winding-up order).

notice_id.description: The Gazette notice ID as requested: numeric (e.g. '4420724') or legacy (e.g. 'L-57793-2040').

notice_type.description: The Gazette's own notice type label (e.g. 'Appointment of Administrators').

notice_url.description: The notice's page on The Gazette (https://www.thegazette.co.uk/notice/{id}).

previous_company_name.description: Previous company name from the notice's structured data; null when absent.

publication_date.description: Publication date (ISO YYYY-MM-DD); null when the notice states none.

text.description: The full notice wording, as published, with whitespace collapsed. Read it before drawing any legal conclusion from the notice type.

title.description: The notice's title. Modern notices use the company name; legacy notices use the notice type (e.g. 'Winding-Up Orders').

title: Get Gazette Notice Text and Fields
